title: Shape consumer contract, version 1
description: What a consuming team depends on in a dataset another team produces. `requires` is a contract v1 body (see `shape check`); extra tables and columns of the producer are always allowed.

owner.description: who to contact when this contract breaks

source.description: the producer's source name in shape.yml

since.description: the date the consumer started to depend on this, YYYY-MM-DD

requires.description: a contract v1 body limited to the tables, columns and rules the consumer depends on
